events.summary: Share Your Story as an International Student
events.description:
iSTUDENTS: The Center for Race, Immigration, Citizenship, and Equality (RICE) at UC Law San Francisco is conducting a research study on international student experiences in the U.S. If you are on an F, M, J visa, or OPT status, you’re invited to participate in a short survey and a 45-minute interview (in person or via Zoom).

Your voice matters—help us understand how immigration status shapes your sense of belonging across race, language, culture, and life goals.

✅ Flexible scheduling
🎁 $20 gift card upon interview completion
🔒 Confidential and IRB-approved

iScholars & iStudents: Wednesday Coffee and Crafts is an informal, social gathering that provides attendees an opportunity to meet people, make friends, and practice English with local volunteers and fellow international community members. Wednesday Coffee and crafts is an excellent resource for all of your questions as you adjust to your new surroundings.

Attendees have the option of participating in a volunteer-led planned activity (often a craft) while chatting. While we love children, we are unable to accommodate young children at this event. This will be an adults-only gathering.

events.summary: Virtual: "Maintaining Your Legal Status: Understanding the End of Duration of Status"
events.description:
Confused about what "Duration of Status" and "Fixed Admission" actually means for your time as an F-1 or J-1 international student at UCSD? Join us for this critical informational session designed to help you navigate the complexities of visa maintenance after Duration of Status ends on September 15. This session will provide a clear overview of the new rule ending Duration of Status and the essential steps you must take to remain in legal standing.
